title: Pure Inpachi
summary: Pure Inpachi normal monster beatdown and mechanical evolution build, chronicling the tragic journey of a possessed tree spirit through Inpachi, Blazing Inpachi, Charcoal Inpachi, and Woodborg Inpachi. The deck deploys Rescue Rabbit and Machine Duplication to flood the board with Normal and Machine Inpachis, turning Piercing the Darkness into massive draws and unassailable battle superiority.

summary.title: Starters & Inpachi Swarm
points: Rescue Rabbit banishes itself from the field to Special Summon 2 copies of Blazing Inpachi, Inpachi, or Charcoal Inpachi directly from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons a Normal Inpachi from your Deck while you control no monsters, setting up Link Spider or Rank 4 Xyz plays.
Machine Duplication targets Woodborg Inpachi (a 500 ATK Machine) to Special Summon 2 more copies of Woodborg Inpachi from your Deck.
Painful Decision sends 1 Normal Inpachi from Deck to GY to add another copy with the same name to your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Rescue Rabbit + Piercing the Darkness
steps: Activate Piercing the Darkness from your hand.
Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon 2 copies of Blazing Inpachi (or Inpachi) from your Deck.
Piercing the Darkness triggers on the summon of a non-Token Normal Monster, drawing 1 card.
Overlay the two Level 4 Normal Inpachis to Xyz Summon Gear Gigant X (or Infernal Flame Banshee).
Detach 1 material to search Woodborg Inpachi (or another Inpachi) from your Deck to hand.
Set Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi to establish omni-negation while a Normal Inpachi remains face-up.

summary.title: Combat Power & Normal Monster Synergy
points: Piercing the Darkness grants your battling Normal Inpachis ATK equal to the opponent's battling monster's ATK during damage calculation, ensuring your 1850 ATK Blazing Inpachis defeat any threat in battle.

Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi is an archetype omni-negate Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster, and summons an Extra Deck monster like First of the Dragons if destroyed while Set.
Woodborg Inpachi protects your LP by reducing all effect damage you take by 500 while in Defense Position with a sturdy 2500 DEF.

summary.title: Extra Deck Payoffs
points: Gear Gigant X detaches 1 material to search any Level 4 or lower Machine monster (Inpachi or Woodborg Inpachi) from your Deck or GY.
Infernal Flame Banshee detaches 1 material to search any Pyro monster (Blazing Inpachi or Charcoal Inpachi) from your Deck.
Link Spider converts a Normal Inpachi into a Link-1 that Special Summons another Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand.
First of the Dragons is a Level 9 Fusion summoned with 2 Normal Monsters: it cannot be destroyed by battle except with a Normal Monster, and is completely immune to other monsters' effects.

main: Blazing Inpachi

Level 4 FIRE Pyro Normal Monster (1850 ATK / 0 DEF): the burning stage of Inpachi, summoned from the Deck via Rescue Rabbit and Unexpected Dai to beat down with Piercing the Darkness or overlay into Rank 4 Xyz.
Inpachi
Level 4 EARTH Machine Normal Monster (1600 ATK / 1900 DEF): the original wicked wooden spirit, pairing with Woodborg Inpachi for Rank 4 Machine Xyz Gear Gigant X.
Charcoal Inpachi
Level 1 FIRE Pyro Normal Monster (100 ATK / 2100 DEF): the burned-out charcoal stage with a massive 2100 DEF for a Level 1 monster, searchable via Infernal Flame Banshee and Painful Decision.
Woodborg Inpachi

Level 4 FIRE Machine Effect Monster (500 ATK / 2500 DEF): the mechanized final form of Inpachi; reduces all effect damage you take by 500 while in Defense Position, and has 500 ATK to unlock Machine Duplication!
